rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: split:refrain.1.1: p608-strip800.jpg and p608-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system: the word the split puts at a line's head is a pronoun of God, printed with a capital anyway. The header's 8.7.8.7. Ref. on p608-strip0.jpg gives metre for the stanzas only, none for the refrain, and no text stands below the music. join:refrain.1.1: p608-strip800.jpg and p608-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system: the second line opens, after a comma, on a pronoun of God printed with a capital anyway. The header's 8.7.8.7. Ref. on p608-strip0.jpg gives no metre for the refrain's lines, and no text stands below the music. movedown:refrain.1.1: p608-strip800.jpg and p608-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system: the moved word is a title of Christ printed with a capital anyway, and the pronoun of God the change leaves mid-line is a capital anyway. The header's 8.7.8.7. Ref. on p608-strip0.jpg gives no metre for the refrain's lines. split:refrain.1.2: p608-strip800.jpg and p608-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's first system: the split opens on a possessive pronoun of God, printed with a capital anyway. The header's 8.7.8.7. Ref. on p608-strip0.jpg gives no metre for the refrain's lines, and no text stands below the music. split:refrain.1.4: p608-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's second system: the split opens on a contraction of the pronoun I, printed with a capital anyway. The header's 8.7.8.7. Ref. on p608-strip0.jpg gives no metre for the refrain's lines, and no text stands below the music.
